note: Variations whose CPU (Java) code takes its angles from js.glsl G.atan2 — a rational approximation (pi/4*(1-(x-|y|)/(x+|y|)) per half-plane, up to 0.07 rad off; G.Kscope uses it too) — not java.lang.Math.atan2. The .flame corpus is authored against the CPU, so gen.ts rewrites every scalar atan2f/atan2 call in these entries' GPU snippets (JWildfire's own snippets call the exact atan2f) to the G_atan2 kernel helper, and java2cu maps G.atan2 / G.Kscope the same way. Regenerate: grep -l 'G\.atan2\|G\.Kscope' <jwf>/src/org/jwildfire/create/tina/variation/*.java -> getName(), minus commented-out uses (bulge) and unportable entries (kaleidoimg).
